question: False regarding crystalloid solutions
question_ar: أحد الأمور التالية خاطئ فيما يتعلق بالمحاليل البلورية؟

options.text: Osmolarity of Ringer lactate solution 273 mosm L
Readily pass through semi_ permeable membrane, therefore they are considered extravascular space expanders
Have poor capillary perfusion and no allergic reaction and short intravascular half life 20_30 minutes
